Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Corpus Christi for 2026, and here is what he found: 31 family events, 15 of them free. The magic runs from November 4 (Santa Photos at La Palmera) through January 6, 2027 (Christmas in La Retama Park), with the Polar Express 3D Movie Night at USS Lexington Museum (November 28), Holidays on the Harbor (December 5), the La Posada Lighted Boat Parade (December 11 and 12) and Coastal Christmas Ice Skating at Hilliard Center (December 22 to 24) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Corpus Christi

  • 31 Christmas events for kids in Corpus Christi, including nearby Beeville
  • 15 free events, including Holidays on the Harbor, Artesian Park Winter Wonderland, the Christmas Festival at Annaville Baptist Church, the Holiday Hoopla at Heritage Park and The Santa Clause Drive-In Movie at the Seawall
  • Meet Santa: Santa Photos at La Palmera, Breakfast with Santa at USS Lexington Museum, Breakfast with Santa at Dave and Buster's, Coastal Christmas Ice Skating at Hilliard Center and Letters to Santa at Coco Cabana
  • Parades and tree lightings: Holidays on the Harbor with the H-E-B Holiday Tree and Illuminated Boat Parade (December 5) and the La Posada Lighted Boat Parade on North Padre Island (December 11 and 12) and the Silver Screen Christmas Lighted Parade in Beeville (December 5)
  • Trains: train rides at the Annaville Baptist Church Christmas Festival (December 6) and the Polar Express 3D Movie Night at USS Lexington Museum (November 28)
  • Season: November 4 to January 6, 2027
